m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Ooh... I bet there are some goodies in here. It'd be okay to steal from Ali Baboon and the Fortee Thieves, wouldn't it?
Ah, but what would the Sultana say? Great sands, she's giving me a conscience! Fine though. Not like I have pockets anyhow.
There's Istar's lamp right there. Let's just grab it and get out of here, right? Yes. Make the Sultana proud. Right.
Am I ever glad to see you! After I refused to grant Ali Baboon's wish, I thought I'd be stuck in my Lamp forever!
I'm sorry, Wizard. I feel so dumb. This is all my fault! When we were negiotiating with the House Qhats, I had what seemed to be a great idea...
To get the House Djinn to support us, I agreed to help them steal the Chronoshards from their Masters. The Shards we gave them were fakes.
I stashed the real Chronoshards away in the Palace Vault. Then, during the Battle, the deal was, I had to let Ali Baboon in to take them.
Wait. Let me get this straight. You made a secret deal involving Ali Baboon and didn't expect to be betrayed? You really are daft.
I know. The House Djinn were working with Eerkala all along. She got the Chronoshards and Ali Baboon got my Lamp as payment for his help.
Oh, I hope you'll forgive me, Wizard. And the Sultana! Oh dear, I should go and tell her the truth right away. Meet me back at Kasra Palace.
Thank you for rescuing Istar, Wizard. She made a terrible mistake, but I have forgiven her. I hope you will too.
So you got the key to get your friend out of the Thieves Den Vault? Her lamp? Wait... she's a Djinni? Well, isn't that something?
You've got a pretty strange circle of friends, Wizard. I hope I can count myself one of them.
Absolutely! You got us in and you didn't abandon us when things got ugly... and you've got Dancers! Say, why not bring your act to Aggrobah?
Maybe we will then. Either way, we're going to hit the road. Good luck rescuing the Djinni, Wizard, and keep dancing!
